name: stop-rules
description: A locked down proxy for Clef on Workers AI, so your team's coding rules hook needs no Cloudflare token.

STOP_RULES_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: The Cloudflare account Clef runs on, 32 hex characters, from the account's home page in the Cloudflare dashboard.

STOP_RULES_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: A Cloudflare API token for that account with the Workers AI permission. It stays on this server and no developer needs it.

STOP_RULES_TOKEN.description: The token every developer's hook will send. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key. Needed only if your repos use the openai judge.
